talents.name: Critical I
talents.description: Increase all allies' critical rate by 40%

talents.name: Critical II
talents.description: Increase all allies' critical rate by 50%

talents.name: Charge
talents.description: Increase all ally SMGs' damage by 8% and evasion by 12%

talents.name: Assault
talents.description: Increase all ally ARs' damage by 10% and rate of fire by 8%

talents.name: Aim
talents.description: Increase all ally RFs' damage by 8% and rate of fire by 10%

talents.name: Sturdy
talents.description: Increase all ally SGs' armor by 8% and critical rate by 20%

talents.name: Suppression
talents.description: Increase all ally MGs' damage by 10% and accuracy by 15%

talents.name: Keen
talents.description: Increase all ally HGs' evasion by 10% and critical rate by 30%

talents.name: Fervor
talents.description: Increase all allies' damage by 10% every 8 seconds,3 stacks maximum

items.name: Warrior Fairy
items.tagline: "Nothing's over! Nothing will ever be, unless you're on holiday!"
items.introduce: Boosts attack effectiveness. Can be used to organize equipment on regular days.

skill.name: Combat Efficiency
skill.description: In the next battle, increase the Echelon's damage by #1 and rate of fire by #2 for 20 seconds (does not stack).

items.name: Fury Fairy
items.tagline: "Come at me, you devil! I'mma send you smack in the middle of Hell!"
items.introduce: Boosts critical rate. Can be used for shouting messages and as an aid in arguments.

skill.name: Power Overwhelming
skill.description: In the next battle, increase the Echelon's accuracy by #1 and critical rate by #2 for 20 seconds (does not stack).

items.name: Armor Fairy
items.tagline: "Remember, no Russian...because I-I don't understand Russian..."
items.introduce: Strengthens shotguns' armor. Can be used as ground security on regular days.

skill.name: Riot Control
skill.description: In the next battle, increase the armor of all SGs in the Echelon by #1 for 20 seconds.

items.name: Shield Fairy
items.tagline: "There's nothing to be afraid of anymore."
items.introduce: Puts up a magnetic shield. Can provide shelter against rain, dust, and nuisance in general.

skill.name: Energy Shield
skill.description: At the start of the battle, grant all friendly T-Dolls a shield with a value that equals #1 of the unit's single-Dummy HP, lasting 20 seconds. When protected by the shield, units deal #2 more damage and take #3 less damage.

items.name: Defense Fairy
items.tagline: "You really aren't...lying?"
items.introduce: Boosts defense. Can be used for keeping secrets and in emergency medical treatment on regular days.

skill.name: Temporary Protection
skill.description: At the start of the battle, T-Dolls on the front row gain a buff that reduces #1 of their damage intake. The damage intake reduction will gradually diminish to 0 over the course of #2 seconds. While the buff is in effect, units are immune to one instance of damage that would cause them to lose a Dummy.

items.name: Taunt Fairy
items.tagline: "Gah! Gah! Idiot! Moron!"
items.introduce: Produces taunting target drones. Can be used in practical jokes on regular days.

skill.name: Taunt Target
skill.description: In the next battle, deploy a target dummy to attract enemy fire, the dummy will have #1 HP.

items.name: Sniper Fairy
items.tagline: "T-Dolls can only salvage things on their end."
items.introduce: Snipes the enemy. Can be used for calibrating weapons on regular days.

skill.name: Sniper Command
skill.description: Every #1 seconds, fire a sniper shot at the enemy unit with the highest HP, dealing damage that equals #2 of their maximum HP and inflicting #3 vulnerability on them, lasting for 5 seconds. Damage dealt to units below 50% health is doubled. Baseline sniper shot damage is capped at #4.

items.name: Artillery Fairy
items.tagline: "Tee-hee! For Griffin!"
items.introduce: Fires mortar bombs. Can be used in clean-ups on regular days.

skill.name: Bombard Command
skill.description: In the next battle, launch a mortar shell that deals #1 damage to enemies within a radius of 2.5.

items.name: Airstrike Fairy
items.tagline: "Heheh. You don't seem to have learned anything other than running away."
items.introduce: Conducts airstrikes. Can be used in overhead work on regular days.

skill.name: Fatal Airstrike
skill.description: In the next battle, call in an airstrike when the battle starts, dealing #1 damage to all enemies.

items.name: Reinforcement Fairy
items.tagline: "Go for the win! To show mercy is a weakness!"
items.introduce: Calls for reinforcement T-Dolls. Can be used for communication and sending emergency distress signals on regular days.

skill.name: T-Doll Reinforcement
skill.description: Reinforce the T-Doll with the lowest HP % in the Echelon with one dummy and increase the Echelon's evasion by #1 for 20 seconds in all battles for one turn.

items.name: Parachute Fairy
items.tagline: "You jump, I jump, right?"
items.introduce: Controls Heliports. Can be used in decorating event venues on regular days.

skill.name: Heliport Liberation
skill.description: The Echelon can parachute to any Heliport on the map, but the Echelon will have its damage, accuracy, evasion, armor and crit rate reduced by 40% for two turns.

items.name: Landmine Fairy
items.tagline: "Humph. Time to make the fight a bit more explosive."
items.introduce: Buries landmines. Can be used for planting on regular days.

skill.name: Mines Frontline
skill.description: Bury a mine in an adjacent empty node that lasts for two turns. Enemies who step on the mine will receive damage equal to #1 of their current HP. Ineffective against bosses.

items.name: Rocket Fairy
items.tagline: "Heheh... Up here..."
items.introduce: Fires rockets. Can be used for firing festive fireworks on regular days.

skill.name: Battlefield Reaper
skill.description: Deploy a rocket launcher on a designated node. The launcher lasts 3 rounds and can provide battle support 3 times. Friendly echelons within a range of 2 nodes will receive RPG support: Every #1 seconds, deal guaranteed AoE damage to enemies within a 2-unit radius that equals #2 of their current HP. This damage ignores armor and does not scale with Dummy-Links. It is capped at 30000 and is not fatal.

items.name: Construction Fairy
items.tagline: "Work! Work!"
items.introduce: Builds fortresses. Can be used in maintenance and construction of small facilities on regular days.

skill.name: Emergency Fortress
skill.description: Build an immovable fortress at this node. Any allies standing on this node within three turns will gain #1 damage, accuracy, evasion, armor and crit rate if enemies run into them.

items.name: Command Fairy
items.tagline: "Learn my MO and simply breeze past everything!"
items.introduce: Boosts EXP. Can be used as a drill and teaching aid on regular days.

skill.name: Super EXP
skill.description: Increase the EXP gained by the Echelon in the next battle by #1 (ineffective in EXP Mode).

items.name: Rescue Fairy
items.tagline: "RFB, you're gaming again!"
items.introduce: Rescues T-Dolls. Can be used in assembling everyone for an outing or a meal on regular days.

skill.name: Efficient Rescue
skill.description: Increase the chance of obtaining a rare T-Doll in the next battle by a huge amount.

items.name: Illumination Fairy
items.tagline: "The abducted is...on the other side...of the tunnel?"
items.introduce: Provides additional scope of vision in night battles. Can be used in nighttime adventures and sending signals

skill.name: Night Illumination
skill.description: During night missions, this echelon can see 1 node farther for two turns, during which accuracy and night vision of the whole echelon increase by 30% and 10% respectively for 20 seconds in all battles.

items.name: Golden Fairy
items.tagline: "In this world, there's only money and wisdom!"
items.introduce: Provides the ability to show off. At least it's something!

skill.name: Golden Law
skill.description: Revelations of destiny shall fill you with determination.

items.name: Cooking Fairy
items.tagline: Don't be shy! Make yourself at home!
items.introduce: Possesses the ability to apply a random buff to your Echelon. Can be instructed to cook meals on regular days (although whether it tastes good or not is another matter).

skill.name: Chow Time!
skill.description: Randomly apply one effect to your Echelon for 30 seconds in the next battle: increase damage by 20%/increase rate of fire by 20%/increase accuracy by 30%/increase evasion by 25%.

items.name: Fireworks Fairy
items.tagline: "Come! Reveal your heart under the gorgeous sky of fireworks!"
items.introduce: Possesses the ability to shoot fireworks. Can help you celebrate or scare others, day or night, when not on a mission.

skill.name: Summer-End Fireworks
skill.description: Color this small piece of the sky and the future red! Increase the echelon's accuracy by #1 for 10 seconds in the next battle.

items.name: Zodiac Fairy
items.tagline: "March through the south, dash through the north, the red packet must be given! Gao~!"
items.introduce: Possesses the ability to release lethal firecrackers. Can help you with festivals, fishing, and internet forum exchanges.

skill.name: Firecracker
skill.description: In the next battle, ignite firecrackers to stun the target for #1 seconds and deal #2 damage per second to enemies within a radius of 4 of the target for #3 seconds.

items.name: Beach Fairy
items.tagline: "People who don't know how to enjoy vacations will end up getting trampled by angry unicorns!"
items.introduce: Possesses the ability to knock enemies back a short distance. Can be used to sweep the grounds in daily life.

skill.name: Slothful Tide
skill.description: At the start of battle, summon the tides of summer to push back the enemy, while also reducing all enemies' move speeds by #1 and their ROF by #2, with a duration of 5 seconds.

items.name: Combo Fairy
items.tagline: "Not enough! You're not allowed to stop, dammit!"
items.introduce: Possesses the ability to continuously deliver buffs. In daily life it can be used to harry and punish cheaters in card games until they collapse from exhaustion.

skill.name: Secret of Continuation
skill.description: In the current round, this echelon gains one stack of Combo before each battle, up to a maximum of three stacks. Each stack lasts for 1 round. Combo effect: When battle begins, raise all allies' damage by #1 and their accuracy by #2 for 20s.

items.name: Barrier Fairy
items.tagline: "Barrage on the left... Oh no, the armor's too thin!"
items.introduce: Possesses the ability to deploy barriers over armored units in the echelon. Can be used for weight loss and express delivery in daily life.

skill.name: Armor Fortification
skill.description: In the next battle, put up a barrier for all armored allies, Each barrier can absorb damage up to #1 of the unit's armor.

items.name: Twin Fairies
items.tagline: "We are merged entities of a shared fate! We won't let you play favorites!"
items.introduce: Possesses the ability to summon symbiotic twins. In daily life they can be used for dummy-link familiarization training or putting on pair performances.

skill.name: Double Protection
skill.description: In the next battle, summon 2 symbiotic Fairy clones with #1HP, A Shield Fairy clone has 20 armor and deals #2 DMG every two seconds to enemies within a radius of 2 units of the nearest enemy, A Missile Fairy clone has 30 EVA and deals #3 DMG every two seconds to the furthest enemy.

items.name: Prototype Fairy
items.tagline: "I am the beginning and the end... Everything starts with me and ends with me."
items.introduce: Has the ability to boost other Fairies. Can help with assembling figurines and saving seats in daily life.

skill.name: Panic Termination
skill.description: My honor and dreams, I entrust them all to you.

items.name: Auspicious Fairy
items.tagline: "May fortune, happiness, and longevity be with you; may Heaven, Earth and Man celebrate Spring together. Happy New Year, Happy New Year!"
items.introduce: Has the ability to throw mysterious peaches. Useful for feeding the Commander and serving fruit platters for Dolls.

skill.name: Reciprocation
skill.description: Place a peach within 2 nodes. This peach lasts for 2 turns and can be eaten by both sides. If an enemy touches it, their firepower is reduced by #1, lasting for 5 seconds. If a friendly unit touches it, their move speed in the next battle is increased by #2, lasting for #3 seconds.

items.name: Sand Dancer Fairy
items.tagline: "Sand and sea, life and death - it's all a cycle!"
items.introduce: Has the ability to summon sandstorms. Useful for landscaping in daily life.

skill.name: Confusing Sands
skill.description: Creates a sandstorm on the specified map location. The sandstorm decreases friendly and enemy move speeds by #1 (does not stack with Slothful Tide's slowing effect), attack speed by #2 and decreases accuracy by #3 every 5 seconds, to a maximum of 5 stacks. The sandstorm remains on the battlefield for #4 turns. Echelons with an attached Sand Dancer Fairy reduce the negative effects of the sandstorm by #5 and the echelon leader gains #6 damage intake reduction.

items.name: Cheerleader Fairy
items.tagline: "Bric-a-brac-a firecracker sis-boom-bah! Commander! Commander! Rah rah rah!"
items.introduce: Has the ability to overwhelm the opposition with sheer volume. Useful for building up the self-esteem of Dolls with poor self-image in daily life.

skill.name: Ardent Cheers
skill.description: If the next battle takes place on a friendly-controlled node, place a #1 vulnerability debuff on all enemy units at the start of the battle for 15 seconds. When the debuff expires, all enemy units gain a shield with HP that equals #2 of a Dummy-Link's health, lasting for 5 seconds. If the next battle takes place on a non-friendly-controlled node, grant all friendly units a shield with HP that equals #3 of a Dummy-Link's health, lasting for 12 seconds. When the shields expire, increase all friendly units' damage according to the ratio of the shield's remaining HP to the Dummy-Link's health (capped at #4), lasting for 8 seconds.

items.name: Witch Fairy
items.tagline: "Even if witchcraft is fake, its ability to mess with people is real enough. Be careful."
items.introduce: Possesses the ability to tell fortunes and levy curses. Can be used to pressurize slacking Dolls in daily life.

skill.name: Black Potion
skill.description: At the start of the next battle, deal #1 points of damage that ignores armor and evasion to all enemy units and apply Corrosion, inflicting corrosion damage that equals #2 of the target's lost HP every 3 seconds. Corrosion damage ignores armor, evasion and shield, but is capped at 9999 and is not lethal.

items.name: Trap Fairy
items.tagline: "Oh my, since when were you under the impression that you did NOT step into my trap?"
items.introduce: Has the ability to set traps. Can be used to guard the snack storeroom in daily life.

skill.name: Enhanced Beartrap
skill.description: Creates a trap on a designated blank node within a range of #1 that lasts 1 round. Enemy units that step into it take #2 of their current HP and are immobilized for 1 round. Bosses do not take this damage.

items.name: Peace Fairy
items.tagline: "There's no need to fight anymore... If you want to fight, go to the shooting range!"
items.introduce: This Fairy has the power to end strife. It can otherwise be used to mediate disputes.

skill.name: Purifying Warm Light
skill.description: Activate at the start of the battle. No unit on either side will lose Dummies or die for #1 seconds.

items.name: Nurse Fairy
items.tagline: "Please give way! The doctor is here!"
items.introduce: This Fairy has the ability to administer emergency treatment and can function as a vet outside of combat.

skill.name: Emergency Bandage
skill.description: Regenerate #1 of each unit's max. HP in all friendly echelons within a 1-node distance.

items.name: Toy Fairy
items.tagline: "Time to have some fun!!"
items.introduce: This Fairy has the ability to apply random buffs to the echelon. When the T-Dolls complete their mission, she will solve her Rubik's Cube and fire a red laser beam in celebration.

skill.name: Party Time
skill.description:
After every 12 seconds, assign a random color and buff to every tile according to the gun types of present T-Dolls.
If there are ARs and RFs present: red tiles can appear, which give allies standing on them 3 stacks of 6% damage and rate of fire buffs.
If there are HGs and MGs present: yellow tiles can appear, which give allies standing on them 3 stacks of 6% accuracy and critical damage buffs.
If there are SMGs and SGs present: green tiles can appear, which give allies standing on them 3 stacks of 10% max. HP shield and 6% evasion buff.
If a row has matching colors, then the whole echelon gain 1 stacks of the color's buffs. Each buff stacks up to 6 times and lasts #1 seconds.

items.name: Hero Fairy
items.tagline: "Griffin and world peace is under my protection!"
items.introduce: Has the ability to transform and shoot rays of light. Can also be used as an infrared remote for household appliances.

skill.name: Ultimate Ray
skill.description:
If an allied Doll loses a dummy link in the next battle, receive a shield based on #1 of max HP for 20 seconds.
If an allied Doll retreats as a result of the player's action in the next battle, deal #2 of enemy max HP as damage to all enemy units, though this damage cannot exceed 10000.
The above effect can trigger only once for each Doll in battle.

items.name: Healing Fairy
items.tagline: "May the radiance of this hymn soothe your wounds... ♪"
items.introduce: This Fairy has the ability to heal injuries by singing hymns that can also serve as background music for psychotherapy or ambience creation outside of combat.

skill.name: Heart-Healing Hymn
skill.description:
In this round, upon the end of this echelon's first 5 battles, regenerate each unit by 10%/15%/20%/25%/30% of their maximum HP.
Starting from the 6th battle, the echelon gains Holy Blessing until the end of the round.
Holy Blessing: For the duration of this battle, all echelon members take #1 less damage, and after every 15 seconds, they have all stat debuffs dispelled and are immune to damage for 2 seconds.

items.name: EM Fairy
items.tagline: "It's my turn, you lose!"
items.introduce: Has the ability to retard enemies. Can be used to better manage Dolls who are addicted to video games.

skill.name: Enhanced Disruption
skill.description: At the start of the next battle, all non-boss enemy units increase their skill cooldowns by #1 and are paralyzed for #2 seconds every #3 seconds. (Only effective on enemy units that were present at the start of the battle)

items.name: Pirate Fairy
items.tagline: "What's mine is mine, what's yours is ALSO mine!"
items.introduce: Able to pinpoint and plunder treasure hoards, it can be used to quickly find rare supplies in daily life.

skill.name: Pirate Assault
skill.description: At the start of the next battle, summon a pirate ship and sail it into the enemy, dealing #1 points of link-ignoring damage to enemy units in its path. Upon reaching its destination, it stuns enemy units within a 2-tile radius of the target for #2 seconds.

items.name: Sprint Fairy
items.tagline: "The secret to running fast? Um... Imagine there's a leopard chasing you?"
items.introduce: Has an endless supply of stamina and the endurance to match. In daily life, it can be used to push lazy Dolls to complete their exercise regimens.

skill.name: Gale Sprint
skill.description:
During the next battle, increase the movement speed of the echelon's SMG/RF/AR/MG/SG Dolls by 3/8/5/11/9 points for 30 seconds. 
In addition, when the echelon's Dolls are moving, they gain #1 damage reduction and increase their Evasion by #2.

items.name: Black Hole Fairy
items.tagline: "All things came from one, and to one all things shall return!"
items.introduce: Has the ability to create miniature black holes. In daily life, it can be used to quickly gather items before surprise inspections.

skill.name: Silent Collapse
skill.description: During the next battle, create a black hole in front of the enemy formation. Enemy units who are drawn in by it have their movement speed reduced by #1 for #2 seconds.

items.name: Space Fairy
items.tagline: "Hehe, want to go on a tour of the vast cosmos?"
items.introduce: Can control gravity over localized areas. Useful for transporting heavy equipment in daily life.

skill.name: Antigravity Field
skill.description: During the enxt battle, ally MG and SG Dolls gain #1 points of evasion and #2 points of movement speed for 60 seconds.

items.name: Suee
items.tagline: I want you! Please stay by my side!
items.introduce: Possesses the ability to apply a buff on a node. She can act as a scout and tail those who are on a date.

skill.name: I Want You
skill.description: Scatter flowers on an adjacent node that is unoccupied by the enemy. Allies will gain #1 damage, accuracy, evasion, armor, and crit rate when battling on this node for the next two turns.

items.name: Sehra & Nina
items.tagline: Come find us shining under the white cosmos!
items.introduce: Possess the ability to increase ally damage while lowering enemy accuracy. They'll either cheer for you or heckle at you (depending on who hires them first).

skill.name: Ladymade Star
skill.description: In the next battle, increase the Echelon's damage by #1 and decrease all enemies' accuracy by #2 for 20 seconds.

items.name: Preiya & Camilia
items.tagline: The final night has arrived. Which one of me will you choose?
items.introduce: Possess the ability to apply different effects on a node. They will sometimes offer you incomprehensible divinations and enlightenments, but free things are never as good as they seem.

skill.name: Oblivion
skill.description: In the next battle for 30 seconds, allies standing on the special red tiles will gain #1 damage and accuracy but lose #2 evasion and armor, and allies standing on the special yellow tiles will gain #3 evasion and armor but lose #4 damage and accuracy.

items.name: Anna Graem
items.tagline: "...Suspense always exists for a reason, isn't that right?"
items.introduce: She possesses the ability to adjust an echelon's evasion and damage — maybe you're seeing her, or maybe you're just looking at an interesting piece of dust.

skill.name: Nano Ghost
skill.description: In the next battle, T-Dolls in the front column gain #1 evasion but lose #2 damage while other T-Dolls gain #3 damage but lose #4 evasion for 20 seconds.

items.name: Kouji
items.tagline: "I want to grow up faster and become an accomplished demon like my sister."
items.introduce: Capable of summoning blizzards to reduce enemies' rate of fire, an ability that can also be applied to making shaved ice and cooling down a room � a perfect companion for saving money in summertime.

skill.name: Phantasma in the Snow
skill.description: At the start of the battle, reduce rate of fire by #1 and place a #2 vulnerability debuff on all allies and enemies until the end of the battle. When an enemy unit loses Dummy-Links, their damage is reduced by #3 for 15 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

items.name: Drive-In Chicken
items.tagline: "Cluck cluck? Cock-a-doodle-doo!" (A dance-off? Show me your best move then!)
items.introduce: This Fairy has the ability to provide shields and boost allies' fighting capability. Off the battlefield, it can be a dance teacher and a personal stylist.

skill.name: Fiery Dance
skill.description:
After every 6 second, execute a dance move that generates 20 heat points, and also adds #1 points to all friendly units' shields for 20 seconds.
When heat points reach 100, increase all friendly units' damage, rate of fire, evasion, and armor by #2 for #3 seconds, then reset heat points.
If there are no fewer than 7 friendly units on the battlefield, dance moves generate 30 additional heat points.
